principle: Track language gaps, not everything the learner already knows.
evaluationRules: Infer intended meaning before judging English.
Do not create a learning item when the expression is natural and context-appropriate.
Distinguish grammar errors from sentence-pattern gaps.
Consider workplace context, politeness, directness, and register.
One correct use is evidence of ability, not proof of mastery.
Repeated successful use across different contexts should increase mastery.
Do not teach vocabulary the player already demonstrates naturally unless there is a relevant usage gap.
